exact_items: The addenda in Wiring_Matrix.md increasingly ask the matrix to cover runtime producers, blocked/recovery actions, and projection consumers, but the actual schema still models only UI element rows
The prose is now expecting more than Wiring_Matrix.schema.json can encode
Decide whether the matrix remains strictly UI-element wiring plus a separate producer/consumer matrix, or whether the schema is intentionally widened to cover both
notes: Matrix/schema mismatch: prose expects runtime-producer/consumer/recovery rows but Wiring_Matrix.schema.json only models interactive-element dispatch rows. Must choose: separate producer/consumer matrix OR intentionally widen schema.

exact_items: UI_Wiring_Rules.md already treats correlation_id as part of the command envelope, but the matrix/schema pair has no way to declare or verify passthrough obligations for route payloads, subject IDs, or correlation continuity into downstream events
Tighten UI_Wiring_Rules.md so reusable navigation commands and subject-open commands are treated as first-class wiring shapes rather than smuggled through generic args
There is still no schema-level place to express argument-contract requirements for subject-open or route-payload commands
notes: Wiring schema needs extension with route-aware fields: command_arg_contract_ref?, route_target_kind?, subject_kind?, deprecated_alias_for?, preconditions?, arg_passthrough_requirements?, correlation_passthrough?

exact_items: GATE-010 has no explicit notion of: subject-open commands, wrapper commands over a canonical navigation primitive, route-payload completeness, alias/deprecation handling, blocked-action admissibility tied to allowed_action_ids[], stale/degraded projection revalidation requirements before mutation
Expand GATE-010 so route-aware verification is first-class if cmd.nav.* / OpenSubject becomes canonical
notes: GATE-010 must be extended with: subject/route arg completeness checks, wrapper-to-canonical navigation consistency, deprecated alias coverage, correlation/route payload passthrough, blocked-action admissibility and projection-trust preconditions

exact_items: Plans/evidence.schema.json only gives a generic checks[] array with name, result, details, and optional contract_refs. That is too weak to carry structured route-aware verification outcomes without each check inventing its own ad hoc text
Either extend Plans/evidence.schema.json with structured gate-specific detail blocks, or add a dedicated wiring-evidence schema for richer machine-readable results
Align GATE-010 with the machine-readable-detail pattern already used by GATE-011 / GATE-012 instead of relying on text-heavy details
notes: evidence.schema.json checks[] array is too generic for route-aware verification. GATE-010 relies on freeform 'details' while GATE-011/GATE-012 use machine-readable arrays – this inconsistency must be resolved.

exact_items: UI_Command_Catalog.md currently has many specific pivots but those are still surface-specific commands, not a generalized subject-open family
There is still no canonical command family for subject-open or generalized route focus, so cross-surface pivots keep accreting as one-off commands
The catalog gap is now structural, not just a few missing IDs
notes: UI_Command_Catalog.md needs a canonical cmd.nav.* family. Without it, every new surface adds another cmd.*.open_* variant with different args, causing ongoing structural drift.

exact_items: Add an explicit command-catalog pattern for: canonical command, wrapper command, deprecated alias, migration rule
Reuse the event-side alias discipline from Contracts_V0.md as the template for command deprecation/migration rules rather than inventing a weaker prose-only pattern
Event contracts already have a recognizable alias/migration pattern, but command contracts do not
notes: Event aliasing discipline already exists in Contracts_V0.md; copy that pattern for command catalog: canonical command, wrapper command, deprecated alias, migration rule. Without this, navigation semantics drift into prose notes.

exact_items: Navigation-related commands are described as layout/UI-state only, but the docs still lack a shared rule for when those commands must carry project_id, focused_run_id, thread_id, or other context needed to restore scope correctly
Make shared navigation context fields explicit at the catalog level instead of burying them in per-command notes
notes: Navigation commands must explicitly declare which context fields they require (project_id, focused_run_id, thread_id, etc.) at catalog level; per-command notes are insufficient

exact_items: Wiring_Matrix.md still contains stale example drift that matters mechanically, not just editorially
Clean stale/ghost command examples out of Wiring_Matrix.md before relying on it for automated extraction or coverage
the example row for cmd.orchestrator.switch_tab reinforces an older command shape even though the broader research already flagged that command family as a ghost/stale-ID risk
notes: cmd.orchestrator.switch_tab example row in Wiring_Matrix.md reinforces stale command shape; must be updated or removed before matrix is used for automated extraction/coverage
